in_telugu.name: రామచందర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is the god of Rama and the god of wealth.

in_marathi.name: Ramchandar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Rama
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramchandar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ram means 'God' and Chandra means 'Moon'. Ramchandar is the name of the deity Rama who is considered the seventh avatar of the god Vishnu.

in_bengali.name: Ramchandar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Rama
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ramchandar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ram means 'God' and Chandra means 'Moon'. Ramchandar is the name of the deity Rama who is considered the seventh avatar of the god Vishnu.
